title: Origins of Sound Recording: Edison’s Path to the Phonograph
lineage: NPS describes experimental designs and uncertainty in the lab sequence, as well as Kruesi building and Batchelor adjusting a cylinder machine; prior knowledge of Scott’s device is not established.
